scope: Theorem 1.2 (Global support and intermediate geometry) of the manuscript “Global Support and Convex Injectivity Domains under Weak MTW” (preprints/Global-Support-and-Convex-Injectivity-Domains-under-Weak-MTW-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 360 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e16087753fc93a84), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 2-3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under (1.3), every potential u, with its dual potential v, has the following properties. 2 (i) Every p ∈ ∂u(x) belongs to Gx and satisfies u(x′ ) ≥ u(x) + c(x, expx p) − c(x′ , expx p) (x′ ∈ M). For every 0 < t < 1, the map Ft : Γu → M, Ft(x, p) = expx(tp), is a homeomorphism; tp ∈ I(x) and x is the unique global minimizing pole of Qtu at Ft(x, p). (ii) For every dual pair (u, v), every x and every r, the lifted section Sx(r) = ( p ∈ Gx : u(x) + |p|2 2 + v(expx p) ≤ r ) is compact and convex. If it is nonempty and r ≥ 0, then diam Sx(r)2 ≤ 8  r + oscp∈Sx(r) v(expx p)  . (iii) For 0 < t < 1, one has Qtu = −Q1−tv ∈ C1,1(M). Its C1,1 seminorm and the Lipschitz constants of the pole and momentum maps F−1 t depend only on M, g, t. There are also rt, bt > 0, depending only on M, g, t, such that, for z = Ft(x, p), u(x′ ) + c(x′, z) t ≥ u(x) + c(x, z) t + btd(x, x′ )2 if d(x, x′ ) < rt.
